name: Chuki Chuki Eroryman
original_name: ちゅきちゅきエロリーマン
source:
I met an older lady, "Kasumi-san," on social media.

She was kind, a little playful, and had a mature, understanding nature.

I thought she was the ideal woman...

But when I finally met "Kasumi-san" in person, she wasn't a lady, but a guy!!

However, she was exactly the same as the "Kasumi-san" I loved so much...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4437660/LOVE_LOVE_SEXY_SALARYMAN/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我在社交媒体上认识了一位年长的女士“Kasumi-san”。

她心地善良，有点顽皮，但也有成熟、善解人意的一面。

我以为她是理想的女人…

但当我最终见到“霞小姐”本人时，她不是一位女士，而是一位男士！

然而，她却和我深爱的“霞同学”一模一样……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4437660/LOVE_LOVE_SEXY_SALARYMAN/]Steam[/url]]
